result.summary: 本文研究如何以最简单的方法实现测试时扩展（test-time scaling）并取得强推理性能 [S1.p1]。作者构建了仅含 1,000 个问题的数据集 s1K，并提出 budget forcing 在解码时控制思考 token 数量 [S1.p2]。在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上微调后，s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%，并可将 AIME24 成绩从 50% 外推到 57% [abstract]。作者开源了模型、数据和代码 [S1.p4]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展和强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。其动机在于测试时扩展这一新范式已被 o1 验证有效，但现有复现依赖大规模强化学习或海量数据 [S1.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, despite the large number of o1 replication attempts, none have openly replicated a clear test-time scaling behavior.
Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
OpenAI describes their approach as using large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) implying the use of sizable amounts of data.

method.text: 方法包含两部分：一是数据构建，从 16 个来源收集 59,029 个问题，经质量、难度、多样性三阶段筛选得到 1,000 个样本的 s1K，推理轨迹由 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1]。二是测试时扩展方法 budget forcing，通过强制追加思考结束符来限制最大思考 token，或抑制结束符并追加“Wait”来延长思考 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者将测试时扩展方法分为顺序式与并行式，并聚焦顺序式 [S3.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We collect an initial 59,029 questions from 16 sources following three guiding principles.
Thus, we go through three stages of filtering to arrive at a minimal set of 1,000 samples relying on our three guiding data principles: Quality, Difficulty, and Diversity.
For each question, we generate a reasoning trace and solution using the Google Gemini Flash Thinking API extracting its reasoning trace and response.
We propose a simple decoding-time intervention by forcing a maximum and/or minimum number of thinking tokens.
To enforce a minimum, we suppress the generation of the end-of-thinking token delimiter and optionally append the string “Wait” to the model’s current reasoning trace

We classify test-time scaling methods into 1) Sequential, where later computations depend on earlier ones (e.g., a long reasoning trace), and 2) Parallel, where computations run independently (e.g., majority voting).

experiments.text: 训练方面，作者在 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 上用 s1K 做监督微调，使用 16 张 NVIDIA H100 GPU 训练 26 分钟 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。评估使用三个基准：AIME24（30 题）、MATH500（500 题）和 GPQA Diamond（198 题），温度设为 0，指标为准确率 [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。对比模型包括 OpenAI o1 系列、DeepSeek r1 系列、QwQ-32B-preview、Sky-T1-32B-Preview、Bespoke-32B 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash Thinking Experimental [S4.SS1.SSS0.Px3.p1]。消融实验覆盖数据选择（随机、仅多样性、仅最长、全量 59K）和测试时扩展方法（budget forcing、token/step/class-conditional control、rejection sampling）[S5.SS1.p1][S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: We perform supervised finetuning on Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct using s1K to obtain our model s1-32B using basic hyperparameters outlined in §D.
Finetuning took 26 minutes on 16 NVIDIA H100 GPUs with PyTorch FSDP.
We select three representative reasoning benchmarks widely used in the field: AIME24 has 30 problems
MATH500 is a benchmark of competition math problems of varying difficulty.
GPQA Diamond consists of 198 PhD-level science questions from Biology, Chemistry and Physics.
Unless otherwise specified, we evaluate with a temperature of 0 (greedy) and measure accuracy (equivalent to pass@1).

We benchmark s1-32B against: OpenAI o1 series, closed-source models that popularized test-time scaling; DeepSeek r1 series, open-weight reasoning models with up to o1-level performance; Qwen’s QwQ-32B-preview
Only Quality (1K-random): After obtaining our high-quality reasoning chains from Gemini, we select 1,000 samples at random
In Table 3 we compare the test-time scaling methods we have introduced in §3.

findings.text: s1-32B 在竞赛数学题上超过 o1-preview 最多 27%（MATH 和 AIME24）[abstract]。budget forcing 使 AIME24 成绩从 50% 外推到 57%，但最终在六倍处趋于平缓 [abstract][S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。s1-32B 是最样本高效的开源数据推理模型，仅用 1,000 个样本就显著优于基座模型 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。数据消融表明，随机选择、仅选最长推理轨迹或仅选最大多样性均导致显著更差性能（AIME24 平均约 -30%），而训练全量 59K 样本相比 1K 选择并无实质提升 [S1.p3]。测试时扩展方法消融中，budget forcing 提供完美控制、良好扩展斜率并取得最佳 AIME24 分数 [S5.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
from 50% to 57% on AIME24
it does eventually flatten out at six times
We find that s1-32B is the most sample-efficient open data reasoning model.
It performs significantly better than our base model (Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct) despite just training it on an additional 1,000 samples.
Random selection, selecting samples with the longest reasoning traces, or only selecting maximally diverse samples all lead to significantly worse performance (around $-$ 30% on AIME24 on average).
Training on our full data pool of 59K examples, a superset of s1K, does not offer substantial gains over our 1K selection.
Overall, we find that budget forcing provides perfect control, good scaling, and leads to our best AIME24 score.

limitations.text: 作者明确承认 budget forcing 在进一步扩展时有两个关键限制：最终会趋于平缓，且受底层语言模型上下文窗口约束 [S6.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。此外，抑制思考结束符过于频繁可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。作者还指出，能否仅用 1,000 个样本达到 r1-32B 的性能仍是一个开放问题 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

evidence.quote: However, it has two key limitations when scaling further: it eventually flattens out ( Figure 4), and the context window of the underlying language model constrains it.
Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
It is an open question whether one can achieve their performance with just 1,000 samples.
